اعتصرتن (form VIII)
# اِعْتَصَرْتُنَّ (iʕtaṣartunna) /iʕ.ta.sˤar.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِعْتَصَرَ (iʕtaṣara)
# اُعْتُصِرْتُنَّ (uʕtuṣirtunna) /uʕ.tu.sˤir.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِعْتَصَرَ (iʕtaṣara)
